newsitem.title: FRANCE: Peugeot heir-apparent Folz gets new post.
newsitem.headline: Peugeot heir-apparent Folz gets new post.

text.p: Carmaker PSA Peugeot Citroen has appointed Jean-Martin Folz deputy managing director of the Peugeot and Citroen branches, further underscoring his role as likely successor to chairman Jacques Calvet.

"He's accumulating positions. He's a member of the management board of the PSA holding company, he's head of the car operations and now deputy managing director of Citroen and Peugeot," a spokesman said on Friday.
Although the company has not proclaimed Folz to be Calvet's successor, "it's quite clear," the spokesman said.
Under company bylaws, which require the chairman to retire within a year of his 65th birthday, Calvet is expected to step down by September 30.
Folz, 50, formerly managing director at food giant Eridania Beghin-Say, came to the PSA group in January 1996.
A graduate of France's elite engineering schools, the Ecole Polytechnique and the Ecole des Mines, Folz also held important jobs at chemicals firm Rhone-Poulenc and aluminium company Pechiney.
